messages:
Maya - Security: quick sync — we need to finalize SOC2 launch criteria for retention + key management this quarter. customers are pushing for per-tenant retention exports and HSM-backed keys.
Jon (Product): +1. can we scope MVP vs stretch? some customers will pay for per-tenant exports but core SOC2 needs are narrower.
Sophia - EngInfra: MVP idea: 90/180/365 configurable retention, account-level export as CSV, and KMS integration for envelope keys. HSM (FIPS 140-2/3) as enterprise add-on (stretch).
Ria - Legal: SOC2 auditors will want immutable audit trails and evidence of key custody. per-tenant export is fine but must include metadata (who requested, justification). also need retention deletion proof.
Matt - Runtime: engineering tradeoffs: per-tenant exports + immediate delete on retention expiration = complexity for live KV stores and cold archives. risk of IO spikes. suggest background compaction + rate-limit exports.
Maya - Security: notes: launch criteria draft -> (1) Audit log ingestion + 1y retention (searchable) (2) KMS integration with customer CMK support (3) Deletion workflow with verifiable tombstones (4) Export API with RBAC + mandatory reason field. Thoughts?
Jon (Product): looks reasonable. prioritize audit logs + KMS for first milestone. exports and HSM can be OKR stretch. we should also capture pricing impact.
Sophia - EngInfra: implementation note — for KMS we can support two modes: API-wrapped keys (our keywrap) or customer-supplied HSM-backed keys via external KMS. HSM path requires extra cert review; estimate +4 sprints.
Ria - Legal: add: retention policy must support legal hold override per account. auditors also expect key rotation policy documented.
Matt - Runtime: rough effort: audit log pipeline + search = 3-4 eng sprints; KMS integration (API mode) = 2 sprints; HSM onboarding = 4. can parallelize if we allocate infra pair.
Maya - Security: decision needed: do we require HSM for SOC2 prod launch? my recommendation: no — document HSM as enterprise compliance add-on. get SOC2 in prod faster.
Jon (Product): agree with Maya. MVP = SOC2 baseline without mandatory HSM. call it out clearly in docs and in sales collateral.
Sophia - EngInfra: action items: 1) create infra RFC for audit-store schema and export API (@Matt) 2) KMS design doc (API-mode) (@Sophia) 3) legal hold + delete proof POC (@Ria/Maya). I'll open tickets.
AuditBot: ticket #SEC-4123 created: "audit-store schema RFC" assigned to Sophia - EngInfra.
Maya - Security: thanks. let's reconvene after the RFCs. target: align scope for next planning meeting on Mon 2025-07-14. :calendar:
Jon (Product): ping in 3 days if RFCs not up. otherwise good to close scope. :thumbsup:
